what: Done-sentinel rollout is specified as a one-line call after larch_quiet_init, but two denylisted wrappers have no lib-quiet init and later EXIT traps in other denylisted scripts would overwrite a trap installed that early
scenario_or_breakage: Backgrounded run-step5-review.sh or run-step2-dispatch.sh never touches LARCH_DONE_SENTINEL, and ci-wait/collector/step2 replace the sentinel trap, so breadcrumb-monitor can wait forever or miss failure completion
suggested_fix: Either move completion into breadcrumb-monitor using the actual Bash task notification, or add a trap-append helper and update each existing trap site; add lib-quiet init/sentinel support to the wrapper scripts only if their stdout contracts remain intact

what: Foreground-duplication guard relies on LARCH_QUIET_BREADCRUMBS_ALREADY_SURFACED being set by the parent and unset by the child
scenario_or_breakage: Environment mutation is process-local; the monitor sibling never sees the child unset, so if the parent exports the guard it exits silently for normal background launches, otherwise it cannot learn foreground FD3 status
suggested_fix: Use an explicit file/status record written by the child before first breadcrumb, or have the caller choose monitor mode from actual tool execution; do not model cross-process state with env unsets

what: Proposed lint treats run_in_background true and breadcrumb-monitor --task-id as shell-fence tokens even though run_in_background and the task id are Bash-tool metadata outside the shell body
scenario_or_breakage: A fence can pass lint by containing inert comments or invalid shell, while real tool calls may still be foreground or lack a captured task id; conversely a correct two-tool sequence may fail because the metadata is not in the fenced command
suggested_fix: Define copyable marker comments that explicitly document tool metadata, or move the pair into a real helper/driver script that launches and monitors itself; update lint to validate that representation

what: Plan documents committed breadcrumb streams under larch-logs but does not add any staging or batch path that would copy the proposed breadcrumbs/<script>.<launch-id>.ndjson files
scenario_or_breakage: Chat propagation may work during the run, but post-hoc larch-logs omit breadcrumb streams despite docs claiming they are committed, and completeness/redaction tests have no source of truth
suggested_fix: Either drop the committed-log claim or add an explicit breadcrumb batch/round artifact allowlist and design-log-publish recursion for the breadcrumbs directory, with sanitizer and tests

what: The plan adds scripts/test-breadcrumb-monitor.sh and says to run make test-breadcrumb-monitor, but Makefile and agent-lint reachability updates are not in the file list
scenario_or_breakage: make test-breadcrumb-monitor is undefined and the new Makefile-only harness can be flagged by agent-lint as dead/orphaned, so the proposed CI command either cannot run or is not protected by the existing harness infrastructure
suggested_fix: Add Makefile .PHONY, target recipe, test-harness shard membership, docs/linting row, and agent-lint excludes for the new harness and sibling contract
